company: vLLM 커뮤니티 프로젝트 (UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab에서 시작)
one_liner_ko: LLM을 위한 고처리량·메모리 효율 추론·서빙 엔진.
what_it_does_ko: vLLM은 빠르고 쓰기 쉬운 LLM 추론·서빙 라이브러리로, UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab에서 시작해 2000명 넘는 기여자가 유지하는 커뮤니티 오픈소스 프로젝트다. PagedAttention과 연속 배치로 GPU 활용을 높이고, OpenAI 호환 API로 바로 연동할 수 있다. NVIDIA·AMD·Intel GPU와 x86/ARM/PowerPC CPU, TPU 등 다양한 하드웨어에서 Hugging Face의 200개 이상 모델 구조를 지원한다. uv나 pip로 설치한다.
key_features: PagedAttention 기반 어텐션 KV 메모리 관리
OpenAI 호환 API 서버·Anthropic Messages API·gRPC
NVIDIA·AMD·Intel GPU, CPU, TPU 등 폭넓은 하드웨어
use_cases_ko: OpenAI 호환 API로 기존 앱에 자체 호스팅 모델 연동

evidence.quote: vLLM is a community project.
Originally developed in the [Sky Computing Lab](https://sky.cs.berkeley.edu) at UC Berkeley
The High-Throughput and Memory-Efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
vLLM is a fast and easy-to-use library for LLM inference and serving.
one of the most active open-source AI projects built and maintained by a diverse community of many dozens of academic institutions and companies from over 2000 contributors.
vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on Hugging Face, including:
Maximize throughput with PagedAttention.
- Continuous batching of incoming requests, chunked prefill, prefix caching
- Quantization: FP8, MXFP8/MXFP4, NVFP4, INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF
- Speculative decoding including n-gram, suffix, EAGLE, DFlash
- Tensor, pipeline, data, expert, and context parallelism for distributed inference
- OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
- Efficient multi-LoRA support for dense and MoE layers
- Support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, Intel GPUs, and x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs.
Deploy the widest range of open-source models on any hardware.
Includes a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API for instant integration.
- OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
